## Verdict

**Dorado** costs least for a team of 18, at **$162 per month**. It is the only vendor whose seat minimum (10) falls below the team size, so the team pays for exactly the 18 seats it uses. Inkwell bills for 25 seats and Borealis for 50, so both charge for capacity the team will not touch.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Dorado | $9 | 10 |
| Inkwell | $14 | 25 |
| Borealis | $19 | 50 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the greater of 18 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Dorado:** minimum 10 is below 18, so 18 seats are paid. 18 × $9 = **$162 per month**. Effective rate $9.00 per person.
- **Inkwell:** minimum 25 exceeds 18, so 25 seats are paid. 25 × $14 = **$350 per month**. Seven unused seats worth $98. Effective rate $19.44 per person ($350 ÷ 18).
- **Borealis:** minimum 50 exceeds 18, so 50 seats are paid. 50 × $19 = **$950 per month**. Thirty-two unused seats worth $608. Effective rate $52.78 per person ($950 ÷ 18).

Dorado is $188 per month cheaper than Inkwell and $788 per month cheaper than Borealis — $2,256 and $9,456 respectively over twelve months.

## Risks

Dorado holds the lowest per-seat rate as well as the lowest minimum, so it stays cheapest at every headcount above 10 on list price alone. Below 10 people its $90 floor applies, but no vendor here beats that at small sizes either.

Inkwell's and Borealis's penalties are minimum-seat artefacts, not rate differences. Inkwell's effective rate drops to its list $14 once the team reaches 25; Borealis's drops to $19 at 50. Neither undercuts Dorado's $9 at any size, so growth does not reorder the ranking.

This is a price comparison only. The price list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, security, or integrations, so a cheaper seat may buy a smaller product — nothing in the source confirms or rules that out.

All figures assume list pricing billed monthly, as stated. Annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees, and switching costs are not in the price list and could change these totals. Confirm whether seat minimums are enforced at signup only or persist as contractual floors if the team shrinks.
